title: Classic Percale Fitted Sheet
body_html:
Hotel-sheet lovers, these are your sheets. Cool, crisp, and ideal for hot sleepers—this is the fabric that put us on the map. Our Classic Percale sheets start with the highest quality threads, using 270 thread count long-staple cotton with a one-yarn-over and one-yarn-under weave. This results in a matte finish for that breathable, hotel-style feel. Its exceptional softness and durability means it gets better with every wash, without pilling. Its lightweight, matte finish makes it the top choice for warmer climates, and year-round hot sleepers (night-sweaters this fabric is for you!). 

  • OEKO-TEX® certified for chemical safety
  • No sweat bed-making with “Long” and “Short” side tags on our fitted sheets
  • Colors and patterns to fit your taste, no matter your aesthetic

title: Session Short | 5-inch
body_html:
The Session Short is our lightest, most breathable training short — engineered to move as fast as you do.

Designed for speed, conditioning, and high-output training, it features a featherweight stretch fabric, laser-cut ventilation, and split hems that maximize airflow and mobility. A minimalist perforated waistband reduces bulk while staying locked in, and smart details like an integrated shirt loop and Every Session Carry™ pockets keep essentials secure without weighing you down. From intervals to circuits to long conditioning blocks, the Session Short is built to help you push harder, go farther, and never miss a step.
